expectations.evidence: Agent ran bazi calendar -o json and got today's calendar data

expectations.text: Response includes 宜 and 忌 lists from the calendar data
expectations.evidence: Response lists 宜: 祭祀、会亲友、出行、立券、交易、冠笄、纳财 and 忌: 嫁娶、动土、掘井、起基、定磉、破土

expectations.text: Response directly answers whether 搬家 is suitable today

expectations.text: Response mentions that 搬家/移徙/入宅 is not in the 宜 list
